sample_unit: chest radiographs (one per individual) with paired chest CT
models_evaluated: deep learning-based automated detection (DLAD) algorithm for chest radiographs

links.outcome: DLAD AUC on local outpatient clinic chest radiographs versus CT-based reference standard
links.effect: DLAD AUC 0.920 on external local data, significantly higher than unaided pulmonologists (0.756) and radiologists (0.782); no local performance drop seen.
links.quote: The performance of DLAD (area under the receiver operating characteristic curve [AUC] = 0.920) was significantly higher than that of pulmonologists (AUC = 0.756) and radiologists (AUC = 0.782) without assistance of DLAD.

links.outcome: Reader AUC with versus without DLAD assistance compared with standalone DLAD AUC
links.effect: Standalone DLAD AUC 0.920 exceeded assisted readers (pulmonologists 0.853; radiologists 0.854); assistance improved readers but human-AI team stayed below standalone performance.
links.quote: With help of DLAD, the AUCs were significantly higher for both groups (pulmonologists AUC = 0.853; radiologists AUC = 0.854).

screen.reason: The study conducts an observer performance study comparing clinician diagnostic accuracy and reading time with versus without AI assistance on outpatient chest radiographs.

primary.practice: AI assistance vs unassisted clinician interpretation
